scientific_question: Do two externally literature-motivated smooth monotonic halo mass-growth histories anchored at exactly the same immutable E17D2b0 reference mass at z0=.95 yield distinct past/future M(z) and EXTERIOR Newtonian monopole time derivatives while leaving the published E17D2b0 conditional c200c(M0,z0) reference identical? This tests history dependence of the external source; it does NOT infer true eBOSS LRG/ELG halo formation, replace self-consistent Vlasov dynamics or claim physical finite-K B.

published_theory.author: Wechsler, Bullock, Primack, Kravtsov, Dekel (2002), Concentrations of Dark Halos from Their Assembly Histories, Astrophys J 568 52, DOI 10.1086/338765
published_theory.published_functional_form: M(a)=M(a0) exp[-2 a_c (a0/a -1)] is a one-parameter FITTING FORM for simulation halo assembly, not a deterministic inference from a single median c200c population value.
published_theory.strict_mass_convention_caveat: Wechsler original fits and c-assembly relation use virial halo M_vir/c_vir; E17D2b0 anchors are M200c/c200c DM14. Using the exponential mass-history SHAPE for conditional M200c is an additional test ansatz NOT validated by the source, and no cvir<->c200c conversion, concentration-formation fit or statistical calibration is asserted.
published_theory.scatter_and_cosmology_caveat: Wechsler fit source simulation and DM14 2014 Planck2013 DM-only are NOT identical to each other or to original frozen CLASS m_nu=.06 eV/h=.6736. The a_c values below are deterministic QA anchors, not measured formation epochs or credible brackets.

exact_conditional_math.mass_history: M_alpha(z)=M0 exp[-alpha*((1+z)/(1+z0)-1)] = M0 exp[-alpha*(z-z0)/(1+z0)], alpha=2a_c QA only. This is a time-parameterized conditional functional ansatz with original Wechsler virial-to-M200c mismatch flagged.
exact_conditional_math.dimensionless_growth_rate: d ln M/d ln a = alpha (1+z)/(1+z0), and at z=z0 equals alpha. d ln M/dz = -alpha/(1+z0), exact.
exact_conditional_math.background: Only original DM14 flat matter+Lambda conditional snapshot H(z)=100 hDM sqrt[Omega_m(1+z)^3+OmegaLambda] in km/s/Mpc; rho_crit=3H^2/(8 pi G). This is not a fresh CLASS run and not a self-consistent original CLASS+halo background.
exact_conditional_math.radius: r200c_phys(z)=[3 M_alpha(z)/(4 pi 200 rho_crit_DM14(z))]^(1/3). For each mass choose Rphys=3*r200c(z0), verify Rphys>r200c(z) for both alpha histories at all frozen z nodes. This is a synthetic EXTERIOR test radius, not observed halo location.
exact_conditional_math.Newtonian_exterior: For a spherically symmetric isolated halo exterior R>r200(z), physical instantaneous Phi_ext(R,z)=-G M_alpha(z)/R and g_r=-G M_alpha(z)/R^2; exact Newtonian shell theorem at fixed R. Do NOT call this full FRW gauge potential, a Fourier halo perturbation, retarded neutrino response or long-short B.
exact_conditional_math.time_derivative: At fixed physical exterior R, d ln |Phi_ext| / d ln a = alpha (1+z)/(1+z0). d ln|Phi_ext|/dz=-alpha/(1+z0). Under DM14 background only, physical cosmic-time d ln M/dt=alpha*(1+z)/(1+z0)*H_DM14(z) where H must be converted from km/s/Mpc to seconds^-1 using 3.0856775814913673e19 km/Mpc. Do not use E17D1 dimensionless u as physical time.
exact_conditional_math.independent_finite_difference: At z0=.95 use original +/- .005 nodes to calculate (ln M(.955)-ln M(.945))/.01 and central mass finite difference; compare exact -alpha/(1+z0) with explicit two-sided derivative tolerance. Original three-node samples are only QA, not fitted formation history.
exact_conditional_math.common_anchor: For both alpha values at each mass, M(z0) identical to exactly SHA-gated original E17D2b0 median c200c(M0,z0), r200c(z0) and r_s(z0). No evolution or fit of c200c(z) outside the anchor: cvir vs c200c MUST NOT be identified.
exact_conditional_math.histories_are: Literature-motivated smooth positive monotone parameterizations with TWO SELECTED math QA alpha values; NOT an empirically validated distribution of M200c assembly at z~.95, individual merger tree, HOD or physically unique halo history.
exact_conditional_math.proof_scope: Same anchored M0, c200c(z0) and exterior Phi_ext(z0) yield two different analytic dlnM/dlna at z0 (.4 vs .8). This demonstrates underdetermination within the conditional ansatz, not nonuniqueness of an initial-value solution or a detection.

original_scoped_outputs.exact_four_trajectory_reports: Two original immutable E17D2b0 mass anchors x two Wechsler alpha QA values; three fixed z snapshots per report with M200c, r200c, fixed-R exterior Phi/g, growth rate and exact/finite-difference derivatives; four original reports, original joint, independent pure-stdlib certificate and SHA manifest.
original_scoped_outputs.independent: Do not import original E17D2b1 worker/NumPy/SciPy/CLASS. Re-derive source DM14 anchor from original SHA-gated E17D2b0 median case, Wechsler exponential M(z), physical critical radius/field and finite-difference identity independently. SHA tamper negative control.
original_scoped_outputs.no_artificial_original_E16_grid_duplicat: E17D2b1 is a spherical far-exterior time-history QA only; no duplicate 576 angular modes, no fabricated long-short coupling, and E16 original geometry is gated without adding science samples.
